scope: AP authenticator reached by management 0x013dfb20, group creation and wpa_supplicant_create_ap. The AccessPoint owner supplies management, beacon, canonical peer leases, physical driver effects and WPS registrar integration.

facts: PSK verification precedes PTK acceptance
Association security IE must match message 2
WPA2 carries encrypted GTK KDE in message 3
WPA sends a separate encrypted two-message group handshake
Pairwise and group handshakes allow four transmissions
Pairwise install failure disconnects instead of authorizing
EAPOL descriptor and key data lengths are checked
Pending replay counters distinguish requests from replies
Requests require valid MIC and increasing request replay counter
TKIP descriptor version uses HMAC-MD5 and RC4-drop256
CCMP descriptor version uses truncated HMAC-SHA1 and AES key wrap
Replay windows are invalidated when a reply is accepted
Reassociation restarts peer authentication
Teardown cancels peer timeout work and removes temporal keys
Group rekey waits for participating peers before activating the new group key
Pairwise key expansion uses sorted MAC addresses and sorted nonces
TKIP consumes 64 PTK bytes and CCMP consumes 48 PTK bytes
PSK peers do not enter enterprise EAP authentication
WPS can force EAP processing without enterprise mode
EAPOL encryption follows actual pairwise-key installation
Disconnection clears authorization and association
Peer authorization notification is conditional on changed state
Default GTK rekey is 600 seconds
Default GMK rekey is 86400 seconds
Default key management is PSK
This AP creation path enables WPA only for personal key management
It does not enable ieee802_1x or configure enterprise EAP users
Only the internal WPS registrar is configured on this path
source_inspected.reachability: Enterprise INITPMK code exists in the generic authenticator but is not enabled by this management AP configuration. WPS EAP remains owned by wireless_station_wps_registrar and is not replaced with a PSK result.

qualification: The listed implementation C translation units contain no NONMATCHING markers; the wpa_auth and supplicant_ap_control promoted API headers were also inspected. Names locate functions, not behavior. No x70view build was run.

byte_confirmed.fact: Configuration invokes the personal-key-management predicate before writing the protocol field at BSS offset 0x15c; key management and pairwise fields are copied separately.
hostapd_get_seqnum obtains driver pointer from hapd offset 0x51c, checks driver callback offset 0xb0, and returns zero without writing sequence when the callback is null.
The committed wpa_drivers table contains concrete driver pointer 0x013e0cf4 followed by NULL.

Concrete driver sequence callback at 0x013e0cf4 + 0xb0 = 0x013e0da4 is NULL. The RSC initialized to zero by the authenticator remains zero on this actual driver. No invented sequence-read hardware request is emitted.
The inactivity helper tests concrete driver callback offset 0xe0 and returns zero when null. Slot 0x013e0dd4 is null on the actual driver.

An associated peer with null inactivity callback repeatedly resets timeout state 0 and reschedules the configured inactivity period. The source default is 300 seconds. An unassociated pending peer bypasses this reset: state 0 sends disassociation reason 4, state 1 follows after one second, and state 2 follows after another second to deauthenticate with reason 2 and free the peer. Explicit removal state 3 immediately frees the peer. AccessPoint owns these management timers.

Open-system authentication sets station flags bit 0 at 0x013a33ec..0x013a33f4 before calling WPA_AUTH and the MLME authenticate notification. The authentication reply is sent only later at 0x013a3504. Open authentication admission is not ACK-gated; association publication and WPA authorization remain separate. AccessPoint owns this management admission.
EAPOL receive rejects unknown/nonassociated peers, bounds the IEEE 802.1X body length, ignores trailing octets, and checks EAPOL-Key type 3 before descriptor dispatch.

providers.crypto: wireless_association::station::crypto: MasterKey, PairwiseKeys, HMAC-SHA1, AES key wrap
providers.randomness: One root-owned crypto::random::RandomPool with canonical RtosClock and external xm1_rtos_own_first::slot_100; no host clock or ungrounded hardware RNG callback

api.construction: new(ap, protocol, cipher, ssid, credential); initialize(shared_pool, canonical_clock)
api.input: associated(peer, information_elements, Milliseconds); receive_eapol(peer, frame, Milliseconds, shared_pool, canonical_clock); tick(Milliseconds, shared_pool, canonical_clock)
api.completion: next_effect emits one identified physical operation. effect_complete(id, result) rejects stale peer generations and duplicate IDs. is_authorized becomes true only after pairwise install and authorization both complete successfully.
api.teardown: disconnected(peer) invalidates peer work and queues revocation/removal. cancel clears pending work, queues all peer and group-key removals, and is_drained gates physical teardown.

owned_corrections: Driver authorization completion gates publication instead of assuming success from a void callback
A newly rotated GTK is activated only after participating peers acknowledge it; joins are held during rotation
Counter overflow is an explicit failure, never a nonce wrap
A 32-byte management key is a passphrase; only 64 hexadecimal characters denote a direct PSK
randomness_limit: Exact target RTOS random_pool_ready returns true without the Linux entropy-readiness checks. Reusing the actual tick-byte and hostap-pool provider does not establish cryptographic entropy strength. No hardware or host entropy source is invented.

behavior: WPA2 encrypted GTK delivery and completion-gated authorization
WPA TKIP pairwise installation and RC4 group-key delivery
Four bounded lost-message transmissions followed by revocation/deauthentication
Bad MIC rejection without key installation
Canceled outstanding effects cannot authorize a peer
Enterprise-only, incompatible cipher and truncated association rejection
Failed initial group install does not start a BSS
Group key rotation waits for peer acknowledgment before driver activation

verification: No build, test, lint, formatter, native, SDK, emulator or camera operation was performed. Source inspection and bounded owner-input byte reads only. Integration must register modules and tests in the canonical graph.
